connect.plaintextBody: %{url} is not a loopback address and has no TLS: the access password and all terminal content will travel over the network in plaintext. Use https:// behind a reverse proxy instead.

overview.clearAllDeadBody: The following ended session records will be removed from all projects, regardless of the current filters.
overview.clearAllDeadFootnote: Only records are deleted. No processes are affected. This cannot be undone.

update.title: Updates
update.intro: Check the latest GitHub release. On macOS, Falcon.app is replaced and the local service is reinstalled with its existing arguments. Restart when ready; unsaved file changes are confirmed first.
update.unsupported: In-app updates are unavailable on this platform. Download the installer from GitHub Releases.
update.installedRelaunch: Installed v%{version}. The local service was reinstalled with its existing arguments. Restart Falcon to use the new version. The previous app is backed up at %{backup}.
update.installedFresh: Installed v%{version}. The local service was reinstalled with its existing arguments. Restart Falcon from Applications to use the new version.
update.installedOther: Replaced the installed Falcon.app with v%{version}. This process is not running from that app and was not replaced.
update.staged: Installer downloaded to %{path}. It would close running Falcon instances, so it was not launched. Quit Falcon before running it.
update.confirmBody: Download %{asset}, replace the local Falcon.app and reinstall the local service with its existing arguments. The service restarts briefly; durable sessions continue. Restart Falcon after installation. Unsaved file changes are confirmed first.
update.relaunchFootnote: The update is installed. Continuing discards unsaved changes and opens the new version.
update.relaunchFailed: The new version is installed but could not be reopened. Quit Falcon and open it from Applications.
update.confirmBodyDownload: Download %{asset}. This installer would close running Falcon instances, so it will only be downloaded, not launched.
update.badUrl: The download URL does not belong to this GitHub release

serverUpdate.title: Server update
serverUpdate.intro: Update the Falcon server on the node above. Installation restarts the service; polling resumes when it reconnects and continues even after this dialog closes.
serverUpdate.confirm: Update the Falcon server on %{target} to v%{version} and restart that node? Non-durable sessions on that node will be interrupted and unsaved work may be lost; durable sessions can reconnect after the restart. Continue?
serverUpdate.requestFailed: Unable to query or update this node. Check the connection and try again.
serverUpdate.reconnecting: Connection interrupted. Waiting for the node to reconnect and report the result. The update will not be submitted again.
serverUpdate.missingTask: The node returned no update task, so the request outcome is unknown. Check the node version and status again before retrying.
serverUpdate.phase_unknown: Updating the node to v%{version}; waiting for the result…

multi.deleteFootnote: All %{n} worktrees under this directory will be removed; repository branches will be kept.
multi.deleteVirtualDirFootnote: Falcon's generated virtual project directory and all its files will also be deleted. Member repositories and custom working directories will not be deleted.
multi.repoLimit: At most 16 member repositories are supported.

worktree.archiveBody: Hide this project from the sidebar and delete its directory, including uncommitted changes, after %{days} days. You can restore it until then. Branch %{branch} will be kept.
worktree.deleteBodyClean: Delete directory %{dir}. The working tree is clean; branch %{branch} will be kept. This cannot be undone.
worktree.deleteBodyDirty: Delete directory %{dir}, including uncommitted changes. Branch %{branch} will be kept. This cannot be undone.
worktree.deleteBodySessions: This will also terminate %{n} sessions and kill their running commands.
worktree.cascadeFootnote: All %{n} derived projects and their worktree directories will also be removed. The source project's own directory will be kept.
worktree.deleteDirtyMore: %{n} more uncommitted changes are not listed
worktree.deleteDirtyIgnored: %{n} .gitignore files will also be deleted (.env, local databases, etc.)
worktree.deleteAhead: %{n} commits have not been pushed to a remote
worktree.deleteMissing: The directory is already missing; only the project record will be removed
worktree.deleteStatusUnknown: Cannot read the worktree status or verify whether it contains unsaved changes
worktree.leftoverTitle: Some directories could not be removed

durable.enableBody: Falcon's session daemon (falcon-sessiond %{version}) will be uploaded to ~/.falcon/bin/ on %{host}, pushed and verified by Falcon directly — the host does not need internet access. Once enabled, sessions survive SSH disconnects and Falcon restarts.
durable.authNote: Authorization is remembered per host (host + port + username); other projects on the same machine will not ask again.
durable.authDeny: Not now (can be changed later from the command palette)
durable.failTitle: Could not enable durable sessions on %{host}
durable.installSkip: Skip for now (session will be non-durable)
durable.autoRetried: Retried automatically %{n} times and still failed — check the SSH connection to the host and its disk space.
durable.channelError: The deployment channel to the backend disconnected
durable.skippedTitle: Durable sessions not enabled this time
durable.skippedBody: You can enable durable sessions for this host later from the command palette.
durable.readyBody: The %{n} existing sessions stay non-durable — only newly created sessions are managed by the session daemon.
durable.reason_arch_unsupported: There is no session daemon build for the host's OS / architecture
durable.reason_dir_not_writable: Could not create the .falcon directory in the host's home directory
durable.reason_probe_failed: Could not probe the host (the SSH command did not run, or the OS type was not recognized)
durable.reason_upload_failed: Uploading the session daemon was interrupted (SSH channel dropped or the host's disk is full)
durable.reason_verify_failed: The session daemon cannot run on the host (possibly a noexec mount or incompatible architecture)
durable.reason_sessiond_unavailable: This Falcon build does not contain the session daemon the host needs (development builds need cargo xtask sessiond first)
durable.reason_not_authorized: Deploying the session daemon to this host is not authorized yet
durable.reason_windows_job_object: The backend runs inside a Windows Job Object; the session daemon would be killed when the backend exits
durable.reason_unknown: Unknown reason (possibly a record left over from before an upgrade)
